_comment: Meals the avatar can eat (Milestone 10, Task 3; v1 Steps 4 and 7). The id is the option id of the eat activity in data/activities.json. kcal of a meal = portion_factor x healthy portion (healthy portion = reference / meals.per_day_ref). Eating removes kcal x satiety from hunger. healthy is x in v1 Step 7 (1 = healthy meal, 0 = fast food), used for diet quality, craving and habituation (Task 7). Decision 3 (user, 25 Oct 2026): only these two meals until the menus are decided.

satiety.comment: Fills 17% less per kcal, so an avatar fed fast food eats about 20% more energy, close to the 500 kcal a day measured with ultra-processed food (Hall 2019). v1 meals.fastfood_satiety.
